checks.statement: M3 time pickers use updated color mappings compatible with dynamic color.
checks.condition: When applying M3 time-picker colors or migrating from M2.

sourceHistory.summary: M2 comparison identifies new M3 color mappings and dynamic-color compatibility.

evidence.result: Picker container and text colors are bound to Material component/system color tokens.

checks.statement: Represent enabled, hovered, focused, and pressed states.
checks.condition: For time-picker interactive elements.

sourceHistory.summary: State diagram caption enumerates four interactive states.

evidence.result: Time values use shared button-state token variables and fields/dial have focus styling; the complete enabled/hover/pressed matrix was not observed.

implementation.notes: The combined picker state matrix needs runtime inspection.

checks.statement: For vertical dial layout, use dynamic container dimensions with left-aligned headline and 24dp padding on all sides; time selector width 96dp (114dp for 24-hour vertical layout) by 80dp high; vertical period selector 52×80dp; horizontal period selector 216×38dp; dial 256dp, selector handle 48dp, center 8dp, and track 2dp wide.
checks.condition: When sizing a vertical dial time picker and its controls.

sourceHistory.summary: Vertical dial measurement table specifies container padding and component dimensions.

evidence.result: Container, selector, dial, handle, center and track dimensions use component/system tokens; their resolved vertical-dial measurements were not measured.

checks.statement: For horizontal dial layout, use dynamic container dimensions with left-aligned headline and 24dp padding on all sides; time selector width 96dp (114dp for 24-hour vertical layout) by 80dp high; vertical period selector 52×80dp; horizontal period selector 216×38dp; dial 256dp, selector handle 48dp, center 8dp, and track 2dp wide.
checks.condition: When sizing a horizontal dial time picker and its controls.

sourceHistory.summary: Horizontal dial measurement table specifies container padding and component dimensions.

evidence.result: Landscape CSS places selector and dial side by side and sizing remains token-bound, but the horizontal dimensions and 24-hour width exception were not resolved.

checks.statement: Use dynamic container dimensions with a left-aligned headline and 24dp padding on all sides; time input container 96×72dp and period selector 52×72dp.
checks.condition: When sizing an input time picker.

sourceHistory.summary: Input measurement table specifies container padding and field/period dimensions.

evidence.result: Input and period dimensions are token-bound and a left-aligned headline is rendered, but the specified 96×72/52×72 dimensions and 24dp padding were not measured.

checks.statement: Support vertical and horizontal dial layouts; vertical is the default on mobile.
checks.condition: When adapting a dial picker to device layout.

sourceHistory.summary: Orientation configuration identifies both layouts and the mobile default.

checks.statement: Use a modal time picker in a dialog to select hours, minutes, or periods. Use it for a specific time such as an alarm or meeting, not granular values such as stopwatch milliseconds. Keep selection easy by hand on mobile.

implementation.notes: Choosing time-entry use cases and the product’s modal interaction model is a product-level decision.

checks.condition: When a mobile picker offers the dial interface.

checks.statement: Place the container above other screen elements and use a temporary scrim to de-emphasize surfaces behind it.
checks.condition: When displaying a time-picker dialog.

sourceHistory.summary: Container guidance specifies foreground layering and scrim.

evidence.result: Chromium 158.0.8127.18 on local Catalog. 1280×960, Baseline Dial, full motion; observe native top layer and opening/closing animations, then Cancel, OK and scrim. checks.statement: Give each hour and minute a separate input with a highlight for the selected field, a larger shape/size/font, and a label below. Show AM/PM after minutes for 12-hour time and omit it for 24-hour time.
checks.condition: When using the input selector.

sourceHistory.summary: Input-selector guidance specifies field separation, selection styling, labels, and conditional period selector.

evidence.result: Hours and minutes have separate labeled inputs; AM/PM is hidden when the 24-hour format is active and appears after the minute selector for 12-hour mode.

checks.statement: Use a round watch-face dial; allow selecting hours/minutes by tapping a number or dragging the selector track. Put all numbers on the outer ring for 12-hour time; for 24-hour time put even numbers inside and odd numbers outside.
checks.condition: When using the dial selector.

sourceHistory.summary: Dial guidance specifies shape, interaction, and hour arrangement by format.

evidence.result: The captured guideline prose says even hours inside/odd outside, while the same page’s 24-hour example explicitly describes 0–11 outside and 12–23 inside. The current dial follows that example.

implementation.notes: Do not replace the current rings from this contradictory check. Confirm the intended upstream instruction before changing behavior.

checks.statement: Use a keyboard icon to switch to the input selector and a clock icon to switch to the dial selector. Use Cancel to dismiss and OK to save the selected time.
checks.condition: When providing selector-switching or dialog actions.

sourceHistory.summary: Button guidance assigns selector-toggle icons and Cancel/OK outcomes.

evidence.result: Chromium 158.0.8127.18 on local Catalog. 1280×960, Baseline Dial, full motion; observe native top layer and opening/closing animations, then Cancel, OK and scrim. The keyboard button opened numeric Input. Cancel closed the modal and OK committed 06:10.

Firefox 159.0 on local Catalog. 1280×960, Baseline Dial, full motion; observe native top layer and opening/closing animations, then Cancel, OK and scrim. The keyboard button opened numeric Input. Cancel closed the modal and OK committed 06:10.

Chromium 158.0.8127.18 on local Catalog. 390×800, Baseline and Expressive Dial modal, Expressive Scroll inline and modal; activate the visible mode buttons. The visible keyboard icon switched the Dial to Input and the clock icon switched Input back to the Dial.

Firefox 159.0 on local Catalog. 390×800, Baseline and Expressive Dial modal, Expressive Scroll inline and modal; activate the visible mode buttons. The visible keyboard icon switched the Dial to Input and the clock icon switched Input back to the Dial.

checks.condition: When a mobile time picker is in landscape orientation.

sourceHistory.summary: Landscape guidance specifies side-by-side placement.

checks.statement: Assistive-technology users must be able to select or enter hour/minute values, choose supported 12/24-hour formats and AM/PM where applicable, and enter values manually.
checks.condition: For accessible time pickers.

sourceHistory.summary: Use cases enumerate time selection, format choice, and manual entry tasks.

evidence.result: Separate hour/minute text inputs, period controls, mode switch and Cancel/OK actions support manual entry and 12/24-hour selection.

checks.statement: Provide manual text input as an alternative to the dial. If the screen is too small for a dial, consider showing only the input selector; Android Views currently always shows the dial. Make input accessible from the dial via the keyboard icon. Dial targets must be 48×48dp.
checks.condition: When presenting an accessible time selector across platforms and constrained screens.

sourceHistory.summary: Accessibility guidance requires manual entry, specifies constrained-screen option and Android Views limit, and target size.

evidence.result: Manual input can be opened from the clock through the keyboard toggle and dial dimensions are token-bound, but no small-screen auto-fallback is implemented; the source says to consider input when space is insufficient.

implementation.notes: The platform-specific Android Views exception does not apply to web.

Firefox 159.0 on local Catalog. 1280×960, Baseline and Expressive Dial; 12/24-hour and hour/minute controls. Measured every rendered hour and minute choice in the tested Baseline and Expressive 12/24-hour Dials. Every measured choice was 48×48 CSS px.

implementation.notes: The assessment covers target dimensions. Pointer arbitration between overlapping targets is outside this check.
